description: RANS (SA-neg) verification of the ignisyeet CFD mode; model-vs-model and model-vs-correlation comparisons (verification), no measured data
machine: i7-12700 (20 threads, 30 GB), shared with other jobs

V1_flat_plate_M0.2.quantity: cf at x = 0.97, finest grid (273x193) vs NASA TMR SA (CFL3D/FUN3D 545x385, 2.7055e-3)
V1_flat_plate_M0.2.note: cf rises for x > 1.5 because of the farfield outflow at the plate end; plate CD not compared

V2_flat_plate_M2_adiabatic.quantity: cf at x = 0.97, finest grid (273x193) vs van Driest II (Hopkins-Inouye, r = 0.89)

acceptance_rule_replay_flat_plate.quantity: plate CD at the iteration the CFD-mode acceptance would stop vs the run to 8 orders
acceptance_rule_replay_flat_plate.note: old rule = 3/2 orders + flat window; trend rule = release/v0.4.0 73d22f8 (rans_replay.py)

V4_cone_M2_Cp.quantity: cone surface Cp over x/L_cone 0.2-0.9 vs Taylor-Maccoll (0.10447), 10 deg cone, wall_size 2 mm
V4_cone_M2_Cp.verdict: marginal fail: mean +1.7 % within 2 %, worst bin +2.2 % (x/L 0.5-0.6)
V4_cone_M2_Cp.explanation: the turbulent displacement-thickness growth adds about 0.13 deg of effective cone angle near x = 0.1 m, which raises Cp by roughly 2 %: a viscous Cp above the inviscid Taylor-Maccoll value is expected
V4_cone_M2_Cp.convergence: second-order stage stalled (rms[Rho] -2.2..-5.4, never 3 orders below the reference); wall axial force steady (CFx(wall) 0.1299 +- 0.0006); snapshot of iteration 1000

V3_friction_vs_flat_plate.quantity: friction part of the wall axial force vs flat-plate van Driest II over the wetted area, alpha 0
V3_friction_vs_flat_plate.state: before the boundary-layer mesh redesign: none of the cases converged (stall; the finless body diverges at M 0.8 after LIMITER_ITER 400 and at M 2 from about iteration 1000); values from surface snapshots while CFx(wall) was steady
V3_friction_vs_flat_plate.cause: under-resolved boundary layer: prism layer only 0.4 wall_size thick, then a 12x jump to cells of wall_size + 0.2 d; reproduced in 2-D (V3b)

V3b_plate_with_cfd_mode_spacing.quantity: cf on a 2-D plate with the wall-normal spacing of the CFD-mode meshes vs a resolved grid (sea-level Re, M 0.8 / 2)

V5_herrin_dutton_base_flow.reason: validation needs the measured approach boundary layer of the M 2.46 cylinder (wind-tunnel afterbody, no nose) and a converged base wake; the CFD mode meshes a body with a nose from an STL (no axisymmetric or wedge domain), the flat-base wake is where the second-order stage stalls, and the boundary layer is under-resolved (V3)

V6_sample_mesh_convergence.reason: held: 5 mm M0.8 alpha 0 diverged after LIMITER_ITER 400; 3 mm cases need about 10 GB each and were stopped (OOM kill with concurrent jobs, then held) until the boundary-layer mesh and the stage-B numerics are revised; wall_size 3.5 mm does not mesh (1 inverted prism, 18 unmarked faces)

memory.model: 40 MB per rank + bytes_per_node x nodes (summed over ranks, 3 and 4 ranks)
